english.title: Remove prohibited weapons / ammunition from their place of importation with intent to evade prohibition / restriction
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..),

(A)_[removed]_
(B)_[assisted in the removal of]_
(C)_[was concerned in the removal of]_

(D)_[a weapon, namely **(..SPECIFY THE WEAPON..),]_
(E)_[ammunition]_

the importation of which was

(F)_[prohibited]_
(G)_[restricted]_

by virtue of **(..SPECIFY THE ENACTMENT..) from

(H)_[their place of importation]_
(I)_[an approved wharf]_
(J)_[an examination station]_
(K)_[a transit shed]_
(L)_[a customs and excise station]_

at **(..SPECIFY THE PLACE OF REMOVAL..), with intent to evade the

(M)_[prohibition]_
(N)_[restriction]_
english.legislation: Contrary to section 50(2)(b), (4) and (5A)(a) of the Customs and Excise Management Act 1979.
english.pointstoprove:

remove / assist / concerned in the removal of

the importation of which was prohibited / restricted

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:

(ii) See section 49 for forfeiture provisions

This offence document and associated codes should only be used for offences committed on or after 14 July 2014. For offences committed before this date use document H10649

other.penalty:
Summary: Six months imprisonment and / or a fine not exceeding the prescribed sum or of three times the value of the goods whichever is the greater.
Indictment: Life imprisonment and / or a fine.

Time limit for prosecutions:
Complex

libra.complexpenaltydetails: The financial penalty on summary conviction is the prescribed sum or of three times the value of the goods whichever is the greater
